stock.description: Newlink Technology Inc., an investment holding company based in Beijing, China, focuses on providing solutions leveraging big data analytics and artificial intelligence. Its operations are divided into three main segments: Financial Institutions, Medical Institutions, and Other. The company's offerings include software engineering, technical support, and maintenance services, alongside the sale of proprietary software products. Notably, they provide robotic process automation (RPA) systems, integrated RPA machinery, and intelligent management platforms built upon medical and health big data. Their portfolio also extends to specialized solutions such as medical quality assurance and safety alert platforms, clinical pathway optimization systems, smart healthcare platforms, and remote medical services. Newlink Technology serves a diverse client base, encompassing financial sector entities like banks, trust companies, and asset management firms, as well as healthcare providers such as hospitals, among other customers. The company was founded in 2011.
